summary: Implementation plan to fix the root cause preventing SmartBoard Pro from appearing in the Android Launcher and enabling the Open button in Settings (fixing the AndroidManifest.xml intent-filter category from android.intent.action.LAUNCHER to android.intent.category.LAUNCHER), adding a one-tap Pin to Home Screen shortcut button in Studio Settings, adding a Robolectric PackageManager & MainActivity startup test suite, and rebuilding apk/SmartBoard-Pro.apk for GitHub download.
